s: God will punish the nations around Israel for their crimes.
Judah and Israel will be punished too, for selling the just for silver.
God has chosen Israel, so he will punish its sins.
Israel did not return to God despite many warnings. Prepare to meet your God.
Seek the Lord and live. Let justice roll down like waters.
Woe to those who are at ease in Zion.
Visions of locusts, fire and a plumb line. Amaziah the priest tells Amos to leave.
A basket of summer fruit: the end has come. A famine of hearing the word of the Lord.
God will destroy the sinful kingdom, but will raise up the fallen tent of David.
